effect: Sudden death: in Battle Mode the hurry-up blocks never stop and fill the whole arena
note: Index 10 sets $1C68 = $FFFF and returns to the title. Normally the block list stops at its $FE marker after 80 blocks, the two outer rings ($C0:D60C); with the flag it runs on through all 143 cells (watched to 122 in Mesen). Lasts until reset.

code: X turbo on pad 1 at the title menu
effect: Battle stages 11 (boxing ring) and 12 (trampolines) on the stage select
note: $CC:14C0: 48 X presses in a row, each 7-9 frames after the last (49 presses; about 6.5 s at 8 frames), set $1CB5 and play sound $0D (the jingle GameFAQs mentions). Any turbo pad or fast tapping works, not just the Joycard. 6 or 10 frames apart fails. The Caravan version clears $1CB5 at the stage select, so it never works there.

code: A or START on multitap pad 5 at the title menu
effect: Battle Mode: Y jumps, in every stage except 2 and 3
note: \ sets \ when the pad 5 press that chooses any menu item is A or START. \ then allows the jump everywhere but battle stages 2 and 3 (without the flag, only stage 12 has it). Lasts until reset. Checked with an emulated multitap in port 2 (Mesen), A on multitap port D: \ = \ in all five versions; A on pad 4 or pad 1 leaves it 0.

code: SELECT on the battle player screen
effect: Change that player's colour
note: $CC:2152: each of pads 1-4 cycles its own colour $1CB7/$1CB9/$1CBB/$1CBD through 15 values. Colours another player already has are skipped.

effect: In-game debug menu: press SELECT in Normal Game (STAGE NO. warp incl. 6-0 ending, NO DEATH, FIRE 0-9, BOMB 1-9, BOMB TYPE 0/1/2/4/8, ITEM FULL)
note: Flips the disabled switch at \. Same byte as patches/sb2_debug_menu_<ver>.ips (ROM offset \ = 01). Up/Down picks a line (wraps over 9 lines), Right/Left steps the value, START closes it (and pauses; START again to play). NO DEATH sets 144 hearts, which never decrease (\ only takes hearts below \). BOMB TYPE 4 = spike bomb (burns through soft blocks), 8 = an unnamed fifth type. The last three lines (-) do nothing. Every line checked on the patched ROMs in Mesen. The Game Genie code patches the same ROM byte.

effect: Soft reset in Battle Mode: pause, hold SELECT, press START
note: The battle main loop ($C0:FB11) has its own disabled copy of the Normal Game soft reset (C0FCAF01). Both jump to the reset entry $C0:FA48. The Game Genie code patches the same ROM byte.

effect: Stages 11 and 12 on the battle stage select without the Joycard trick
note: Disabled switch at $CC:239F (LDA #0 / BNE) that skips the $1CB5 check. Europe: CC23FC01, Japan: CC239001. Caravan has its own switch at $CC:250E: CC251001 (checked in Mesen: 12 stages, Left 1 -> 12 -> 11). The Game Genie code patches the same ROM byte.

effect: Caravan version: stages 11 and 12 on the battle stage select (the event build otherwise allows 4)
note: Disabled switch at $CC:250E (LDA #0 / BNE to $CC:2527) that skips the 4-stage limit and the $1CB5 clear. Checked with Mesen's cheat engine: $7F:401E = 11 instead of 3, Left on the stage select goes 1 -> 12 -> 11 (without it 1 -> 4 -> 3). The Game Genie code patches the same ROM byte.

effect: CPU usage meter (a black scanline where the frame's work ends)
note: $C1:00BD: force-blank for a few cycles at the end of each frame's work, in both main loops. The Game Genie code patches the same ROM byte.

effect: Jump in Normal Game (Y)
note: $C1:3D26 switch, calls the battle jump code $C0:6616/$C0:6658. The Game Genie code patches the same ROM byte.

effect: Press R in Normal Game for every power-up
note: $C0:22A0: speed 3, 9 bombs, fire 9, remote, kick, glove, both pass items and 144 hearts (checked in RAM). The Game Genie code patches the same ROM byte.

effect: Soft reset in Normal Game: pause, hold SELECT, press START
note: $C0:FCAD: needs exactly SELECT+START held ($C3 = $3000). The Game Genie code patches the same ROM byte.

effect: Battle stage 11 / 12
note: $1CCD is the chosen battle stage. Checked with Mesen's cheat engine (USA): the stage select shows 11 / 12 and the battle is the boxing ring / trampolines.

code: BOMB TYPE 4 / 8 in the debug menu
effect: Spike bomb (4): the blast burns through every soft block in range. Type 8: a fifth bomb type that bounces off in random directions when thrown
note: \ values; each has its own item counter (\ type 4, \ type 8) and pickup handler (\, \). Type 4 checked in Mesen next to soft blocks; type 8 checked in Mesen (7E80F308 + glove): a thrown type-8 bomb takes a new random direction on its bounces, a type-0 bomb keeps the throw direction; kicking not exercised.

effect: The title menu ignores all input while a mouse is plugged in
note: Europe only: \ reads the controller IDs \-\ and, on a mouse (AND #\ = 2), skips the menu. Checked in Mesen with a mouse in port 2: Europe stays on the title, USA works.

effect: Digits start at 0000; Up/Down change the digit and wrap 9<->0; Left/Right move the cursor and stop at the ends; START or A submits; B goes back
note: \ (digits), \ (cursor), \ (submit, BIT #\). A wrong code resets the digits to 0000. After a game over the screen starts with the current world's code (\-\, from \; static).

effect: Player 1 invincible in Normal Game (144 hearts, which never go down)
note: Same value as the debug menu's NO DEATH: a hit takes a heart only below $80. Own bomb in 1-1: he flashed and played on (without the code he died and 1-1 restarted). Game Genie: a hit with no hearts goes to the heart-loss flash instead of dying (JML $C0:A675 at $C0:833C -> $C0:834A, BEQ at $C0:A650 and $C1:4180 -> the flash, JML at $C1:5567 -> $C1:5576); Mesen, all five: own bomb in 1-1, he played on with his kit (without it he died and lost it).

effect: Speed 3, 9 bombs, fire 9 (HUD 10)
note: Player 1 kit $7E:80E0-$80E2; RAM checked after a bomb. No Game Genie form: speed, bombs and fire are read through the player pointer at about 20 places (and copied to +$F0-$F2), and written only at game start, by pickups and by the R switch C022F301 (which gives everything).

effect: Spike bombs (blast through soft blocks); 7E80F301 remote control, 7E80F302 power bomb
note: Bomb type $7E:80F3; 4 checked in RAM, types checked on screen through the debug menu earlier. Game Genie: LDA [$6A],Y -> LDA #$04 at $C0:350B, the type load copied to each new bomb (+$42); Mesen, all five: the bomb laid in 1-1 got type 4 (0 without).

effect: Both pass items, power glove, kick
note: RAM checked; the glove and kick flags are the ones the pickup handlers set. No Game Genie form built: the four items have four separate tests (wall pass $C0:AF6A, bomb pass $C0:AEBC, glove $C0:30E6, kick $C0:63AC), and the PAR check was RAM only.

effect: Battle stages 11 and 12 without the Joycard trick
note: $1CB5 is the flag the turbo-X code sets. Left on the stage select went 1 -> 12. Caravan clears it at the stage select (no effect there). Game Genie: BEQ +7 -> BEQ +0 after LDA $001CB5 ($CC:23AF; EU $CC:240A, JP $CC:239E), so the stage count is always 12; Mesen, USA, Europe, Japan, beta: Left on the stage select went 1 -> 12.

effect: Jump (Y) in every battle stage but 2 and 3
note: $1C6E, the flag the pad-5 trick sets. The cheat engine held it at $FFFF; the jump itself was checked with the real pad-5 trick (same flag). Game Genie: BEQ -> BEQ +0 after LDA $001C6E ($C0:65F5); Mesen, all five: the jump handler $C0:6616 runs in battle stage 1 (never without the code).

effect: Sudden death: the hurry-up blocks fill the whole arena (password 5656)
note: $1C68 held at $FFFF by the cheat engine; the effect was checked earlier with the flag set by 5656. Game Genie: BEQ -> BEQ +0 after LDA $001C68 ($C0:D615, Caravan $C0:D624), so the block list never stops at its $FE marker; Mesen (tools/sb2/sudden_death.lua with the flag cleared), USA, Europe, Japan, beta: the blocks kept coming past 81 (control stops at 81). Caravan not run (the test never reaches the hurry-up there).

note: No caller and no pointer anywhere; never ran in the coverage logs.
